name: Brenton Awa
summary:
Brenton Patrick Chokei Kawika Awa (born February 19, 1986) is an American politician and former television news anchor. Initially elected as a Republican in 2022, Awa is a political Independent.
Awa has represented the 23rd district in the Hawaii Senate since 2022, which includes the communities of Kāne‘ohe, Kahalu‘u thru Lā‘ie, Kahuku to Mokulē‘ia, Schofield Barracks, and Kunia Camp on the island of O'ahu.
